info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Bank Accounts API
Return the data for all BankAccounts

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of BankAccount records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the BankAccount records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: show_empty_accounts
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having a zero or non zero balance.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having a specific status.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having a specific type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter BankAccount records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: user_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a BankAccount. The list will be filtered to include only the BankAccount records with the matching property.
